short.EN: Intelligent AI assistant that transforms NINA into a conversational imaging system for better astrophotography results

long.EN:
Your intelligent astrophotography companion - transform NINA into a conversational, context-aware imaging system that understands your goals and helps you achieve better results.

🔭 FOR ASTROPHOTOGRAPHERS:
• Quick Session Setup: 'Set up for M31 tonight' - AI configures equipment, cooling, filters, and exposure settings
• Real-Time Troubleshooting: Analyze failed frames, high HFR, guiding issues, poor focus - get instant suggestions
• Image Quality Feedback: AI reviews your captures, identifies problems (tracking, focus, star bloat), suggests corrections
• Learning Assistant: Ask 'Why is my HFR high?' or 'Best Ha exposure for M42' - get expert guidance while imaging
• Sequence Optimization: 'Plan 4-hour session on Horsehead' - AI suggests optimal filter rotation, dither patterns, exposure times

🤖 6 AI PROVIDERS (Free to Advanced):
GitHub Models (FREE), OpenAI GPT-4o/o1, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5, Google Gemini 2.0, Ollama (local), Mistral AI. Dynamic model discovery ensures you always have latest AI capabilities.

🎛️ NATURAL LANGUAGE EQUIPMENT CONTROL (via MCP):
Control your entire observatory through conversation: 'Connect camera and mount, cool to -10°C, unpark', 'Slew to Orion Nebula, center it, start guiding', 'Take 5-minute Ha exposure, then switch to OIII'. 100+ built-in MCP tools for cameras, mounts, focusers, filter wheels, rotators, dome control, guiding, platesolving. MCP now supports Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, AND Ollama (local models).

📊 INTELLIGENT IMAGING ANALYSIS:
HFR monitoring, star detection, background assessment, exposure evaluation, pattern recognition for tracking issues.

🔧 WORKFLOW AUTOMATION:
Multi-target planning, adaptive sequences, equipment coordination, error recovery, session management.

🛠️ EXTENSIBILITY:
Connect external Python MCP servers for astronomy calculations, weather integration, catalog queries, custom automation.

Transform complex equipment control and imaging workflows into simple conversations.

Changes: Real-time tool-calling progress feedback now shows the current iteration and tool in the chat UI
Added 90-second per-tool and 120-second external MCP read timeouts to prevent indefinite hangs
Improved Google Gemini diagnostics for HTTP errors, empty candidates, finish reasons, prompt feedback, and safety blocks
Hardened Anthropic built-in-to-external MCP routing with bounded execution and structured errors
Added the optional nina.autopilot Orchestrator integration panel
Added configurable Orchestrator URL and polling interval settings
Added optional Buy Me a Coffee project support links
Updated release metadata for the Mistral AI provider
New: full conversation history - the AI now remembers the whole chat session, so follow-up questions and 'it/that' references work (all providers)
New: external MCP tools now work with Anthropic Claude too (web fetch/search, memory, etc.), matching Gemini and Ollama
Fixed: Google Gemini 400 error - array tool parameters now correctly declare 'items' (and nested objects keep 'properties')
Fixed: changing the model now applies immediately in chat, no more switching providers back and forth
Improved: Ollama model list auto-detects installed models from the server (dropdown/Refresh re-query; re-detects when the Server URL changes)
Fixed: external MCP servers launched via npx/.cmd now start correctly on Windows (PATHEXT resolution + cmd.exe routing) - unblocks most popular MCP servers
Fixed: stdio JSON-RPC handshake corrupted by a UTF-8 BOM, which prevented strict servers (e.g. Python MCP SDK) from connecting
Fixed: concurrent external tool calls no longer collide on the server stream (serialized request/response IO)
Improved: MCP system prompt now tells the model to use available external tools (web fetch/search, etc.), not only NINA equipment tools
New: 'Useful servers' picker in Options to add fetch, search, Wikipedia, arXiv, memory and more to the config in one click
New: animated 'AI is working' indicator in chat so long tool calls don't look frozen
New: Ollama remote-host guidance for running the model on another LAN machine (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0)
Multiple external MCP servers: connect several third-party MCP servers at once using the standard mcpServers JSON config (Google Gemini and Ollama)
External MCP servers can now use any command (python, node, npx, docker, binaries) with args and environment variables
Tool name collisions across external servers are auto-prefixed with the server name to avoid silent drops
Options UI: replaced single python/script fields with an mcpServers JSON editor plus Validate and Reset to NINA Default buttons (prefilled NINA MCP server template)
Fixed: connect/disconnect all equipment no longer falsely reports success - it now reads each device's actual API Success field and shows per-device errors
Fixed: chat input now preserves multi-line pasted text (Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline)
Backward compatible: existing single-server settings are migrated automatically
Fixed Mistral model dropdown not syncing selection to custom model textbox
Fixed Mistral provider display name showing raw enum instead of friendly name in GetProviderDisplayName
MCP support for Ollama: Local models can now control NINA equipment without paid API keys (requires tool-capable model like llama3.1+)
New Mistral AI provider: Mistral Large, Medium, Small, Mixtral, and Codestral models
MCP section now visible for Anthropic, Google, and Ollama providers
Updated provider count from 5 to 6
Profile Management: View, modify, and switch NINA profiles via conversation
Extended Sequence Control: State, edit, skip, reset, list, and set-target tools
Image Retrieval: Get captured images and thumbnails by index
Event History: Review equipment events and capture history
5 Flat Frame Tools: skyflat, auto-brightness, auto-exposure, trained-dark-flat, trained-flat
Added 7 missing equipment listing/status tools
Fixed 13 wrong API parameter names and schemas causing silent failures
Removed 6 tools mapped to non-existent API endpoints
Universal Quota Monitoring: Real-time tracking of API limits and token usage for all providers
Detailed Token Usage info in the chat header (input/output breakdown)
Proactive Rate Limit Info: Error messages now include reset times
Fixed Google Gemini MCP name collisions with built-in NINA tools
Fixed MCP status caching when switching between providers
Fixed Anthropic connection test model selection
Updated default Anthropic model to Claude 3.5 Sonnet 20241022
Improved UI header layout and stability fixes
Restructured manifest.json to match official requirements
Fixed CI/CD manifest paths
Google Gemini MCP Support
Anti-hallucination System Prompts
Dynamic Model Discovery
OpenAI Reasoning Model Support
